Rates in \% of predictions and differences in points, with 95\% intervals over targets. L4 Triton and A100 Triton use AlphaFold 3's default attention, seeds 1 to 5, first runs. Events (targets): the number of flips and of targets with at least one. Beyond: the interval of the difference lies above 0. The 57 targets leave out the three glycan targets.
